desc: Century Arms RH-10 Classic is an imported Romanian AK47 rifle. Similar to the WASR10 model, it uses a one-piece front sight/gas block combination for a lighter front end. Utilizes a hammer forged, chrome lined barrel with 14x1 LH threaded muzzle. A side mount scope rail allows the user to mount an optic. The RAK 1 trigger group provides a smooth and crisp trigger break.
